contexts.text: The rams of Nebaioth () = Divine spiritual things.
The first-born of Ishmael, Nebaioth, etc () = all things which are of the Spiritual Church, especially with the gentiles. Illustrated.
The sister of Nebaioth... () = the affection of celestial truth... Nebaioth = the good which is of the Spiritual Church.
The rams of Nebaioth = the goods of innocence and of charity there... Nebaioth = those there who are in it.
The rams of Nebaioth which shall minister = the truths which from spiritual affection lead the life.
